full_prompt_en: A broad landscape painting looks across a winding river valley toward a small cluster of pale houses on distant hills. A reddish ocher path or bank cuts across the foreground, while the water begins as a deep blue pool at lower left, bends around the base of a green slope, and reappears in a shadowed channel at lower right. Rounded hills are arranged in overlapping bands of mustard yellow, acid green, olive, and warm brown. In the near middle ground, several tall trees rise like flat ornamental shapes. One has a dark red crown and narrow reddish trunks; another is almost black, with a dense upright mass that divides the distant view. Smaller slender yellow and blue trees punctuate the valley on both sides. Behind them, cream and tan buildings with red roofs sit among patches of saturated yellow fields. A larger simple building stands near the upper center-right, half hidden by trees. The sky changes from dusty violet on the left to turquoise on the right, where soft white clouds hang over a bright ridge. Brush texture and speckled pigment remain visible throughout, especially in the sky and slopes. The landscape is simplified into interlocking color areas rather than modeled with realistic detail. The composition moves from the red foreground through the dark tree silhouettes and curving water to the quiet hilltop buildings, creating depth through overlap, scale, and contrasting warm and cool color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅宽幅风景画越过蜿蜒的河谷，望向远处山丘上一小群浅色房屋。红赭色的小路或河岸横过前景；水面从左下方的深蓝水潭开始，绕过绿色坡脚，又在右下方的阴影河道里出现。圆润的山丘叠成芥黄、亮绿、橄榄绿和暖棕的色带。近处中景有几棵高树像扁平的装饰形状般升起。一棵树有深红树冠和细窄红褐树干；另一棵几乎黑色，以密实的竖向树形分割远景。更小的细长黄树与蓝树点在河谷两侧。树木后方，奶油色与棕褐色房屋顶着红屋顶，嵌在饱和黄色田块之间。偏右上方还有一栋较大的简单建筑，半掩于树后。天空从左侧灰紫转为右侧青绿，柔软白云悬在明亮的山脊上。笔触肌理与斑点状颜料在全画可见，尤其在天空和坡面。风景被简化成互相咬合的色块，而非用写实细节塑形。构图从红色前景，经深色树影与弯曲水道，引向安静的山顶建筑；重叠、尺度及冷暖对比共同建立纵深。
style_prompt_en: Paint with visibly granular, matte pigment and short interwoven strokes that let color vibrate within simplified shapes. Build depth from overlapping bands and interlocking patches rather than detailed perspective. Use an emphatic palette of ocher yellow, olive and acid green, deep blue, turquoise, brick red, and muted violet, with dark silhouettes anchoring the bright fields. Contours can be blunt, gently irregular, and decorative. Rounded forms alternate with tall narrow accents; a winding cool-colored passage guides the eye through warmer masses. Light feels diffused across the whole surface, expressed through color relationships more than realistic highlights or cast shadows. Preserve the grain of the painted surface and slight shifts of hue inside each area. The transferable effect is a lyrical, flattened, color-led composition with clear depth from overlap.
style_prompt_zh: 使用颗粒可见的哑光颜料和相互交织的短笔触，让简化形状内部的颜色微微颤动。以重叠色带和互相嵌合的色块建立纵深，而不依赖细密透视。色盘鲜明，包含赭黄、橄榄绿与亮绿、深蓝、青绿、砖红和柔和灰紫，再以深色剪影压住明亮区域。轮廓可以钝拙、略不规则且富装饰性。圆润形状与修长竖向重点交替；一道蜿蜒的冷色通路引导视线穿过暖色块。光感在整个表面漫开，更多借颜色关系而非写实高光或投影表现。保留画面颗粒，以及每块颜色内部细小的色相变化。可迁移的效果是抒情、扁平、由色彩主导的构图，同时以重叠保持清楚纵深。
theme_en: A winding river among yellow hills and dark stylized trees
theme_zh: 蜿蜒河流穿过黄色丘陵与深色程式化树木
name: Paul Serusier
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
